title: Unify ID, audit, and tenant field naming across protocol layer
body:
- [x] Analyze all occurrences of `_id`, `modified_at/by`, `space_id` across the codebase
- [x] Fix `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` — `modified_at`→`updated_at`, `modified_by`→`updated_by`, `space_id`→`tenant_id`, `_id`→`id`
- [x] Fix `packages/objectql/src/protocol.ts` — `_id`→`id` in all filter/data operations, `modified_at`→`updated_at`
- [x] Fix `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` — `_id`→`id` in filters, data access, and ObjectProxy
- [x] Fix `packages/objectql/src/engine.test.ts` — `_id`→`id` in all test data/assertions
- [x] Fix `packages/objectql/src/protocol-data.test.ts` — `_id`→`id` in all test data
- [x] Fix `packages/core/src/qa/http-adapter.ts` — Remove `_id` fallbacks, use only `id`
- [x] Fix `packages/plugins/driver-memory/src/memory-matcher.ts` — Remove `_id` compatibility shim
- [x] Fix `apps/studio/src/types.ts` — Remove `_id` from Task interface
- [x] Fix `apps/studio/src/components/ObjectDataForm.tsx` — Remove `_id` refs, `modified_by`→`updated_by`
- [x] Fix `apps/studio/src/components/ObjectDataTable.tsx` — Remove `_id` fallbacks
- [x] Fix `apps/studio/src/mocks/createKernel.ts` — Remove `_id` fallbacks
- [x] Fix `examples/app-todo/src/actions/task.handlers.ts` — `_id`→`id`
- [x] Fix `examples/app-crm/src/actions/handlers/*.ts` — `_id`→`id`
- [x] Fix `packages/spec/src/data/dataset.zod.ts` — Update comment
- [x] Fix `packages/spec/src/data/mapping.zod.ts` — Update comment
- [x] Fix `packages/spec/src/data/mapping.test.ts` — `_id`→`id` in test data
- [x] Fix `packages/spec/src/integration/connector/database.zod.ts` — `_id`→`id`
- [x] Fix `packages/spec/src/qa/testing.zod.ts` and `testing.test.ts` — `_id`→`id`
- [x] Fix `packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts` — `_id`→`id`
- [x] Fix `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts` — `_id`→`id`
- [x] Fix `packages/client/src/*.test.ts` — `_id`→`id`
- [x] Fix `content/prompts/` — Update `_id` refs in prompt files
- [x] Fix `content/docs/` — Update `_id` refs in documentation (including actions.mdx endpoint templates)
- [x] Fix `packages/spec/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md` — `_id`→`id`
- [x] Fix `packages/spec/docs/SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md` — `modified_at`→`updated_at`
- [x] Update `ROADMAP.md` with unified field naming entry
- [x] Build all affected packages — all build successfully
- [x] Run tests — all pass (pre-existing failures unrelated to changes)
- [x] Full re-audit: no remaining `_id`/`modified_at`/`space_id` in protocol-level code

**Audit Summary:**
- `modified_at` / `modified_by`: ✅ Zero remaining (only in ROADMAP changelog text)
- `space_id`: ✅ Zero remaining (only in ROADMAP changelog text)
- `_id` (standalone): ✅ Zero remaining in protocol code. Only remaining are:
  - TypeScript unused parameter convention (`_id` as param name) — correct
  - Documentation comments explaining the rule ("MUST NOT return `_id`") — correct
  - MongoDB `foreignField: '_id'` in storage-layer examples — intentionally preserved
  - Standards guide text explaining not to use `_id` — correct

<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> 
> ----
> 
> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>全仓库统一 ID 字段、系统字段及多租户字段命名规范（消除 _id / space_id / modified_xx 混用）</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## 背景
> 现有仓库内关于主键 ID 字段、审计与租户字段命名混杂，存在 `_id` / `id`、`space_id` / `tenant_id`、`modified_at/by` / `updated_at/by` 等并存使用，违反了 SystemFieldName 统一规范，导致 driver、引擎、mock、handler、测试等层面不一致，埋下兼容和维护隐患。鉴于 audit/prompt/mock 多处已传播此问题，需统一整改。
> 
> ## 需要合并解决的具体问题
> #### 1. ID 字段统一
> - ObjectQL、protocol、engine���mock、handler、test、业务类型定义等多处混用 `_id` 和 `id`。
> - 数据驱动接口规定只返回 `id`，但上下游仍有 `_id` 查询/写入/转换逻辑。
> - Studio/types/action handlers/示例代码需移除 `_id`，统一投射 `id`。
> 
> #### 2. 审计字段统一
> - `created_at`、`updated_at` 应作为标准，部分 audit hook 使用 `modified_at`/`modified_by`。
> - 所有自动审计挂钩、业务代码、mock、prompt 均应重命名为 `updated_at`/`updated_by`。
> 
> #### 3. 多租户隔离字段统一
> - 租户字段只能用 `tenant_id`，ObjectQL 插件/中间件实现和协议层应全部移除 `space_id`。
> 
> #### 4. Prompt 和开发者文档示例同步
> - 包含 seed 脚本、示例、testing schema 等，应禁止 `_id`，只用 `id`。
> 
> #### 5. Mock/插件/devPlugin
> - 返回类型、filter、insert/update/delete、record capture 等全面清查。
> 
> #### 6. Testing
> - 所有相关用例和 scenario 中不再混用 `_id`，只出现 `id`。
> 
> ## 建议修复方案（合并执行）
> 1. 全文自动/人工替换 `_id` → `id`，`modified_at` → `updated_at`，`space_id` → `tenant_id`（兼容层/适配器除外）。
> 2. 引擎、插件、对象协议、mock、action handler、dev-plugin、http-adapter、testing schema、prompt 全面梳理改写。
> 3. 强制内部和协议文档一致，所有接口入参出参、主数据类型只出现一套规范命名。
> 4. 提供一次性升级 migration/说明文档。
> 
> ## 影响面
> - packages/objectql
> - packages/core
> - packages/plugins/driver-memory
> - examples/
> - apps/studio/
> - content/prompts/
> - packages/spec/
> - 及所有 demo/test/mock/工具层
> 
> ## 风险
> - 第三方驱动或定制插件/适配层如因历史原因必须用 `_id`，需做兼容适配（如 storage column 映射）；主协议层、SDK、API 不再暴露 `_id`。</issue_description>
>
